summary: E-Power Inc. filed a 6-K reporting a registered direct offering priced September 29, 2026 and closed September 30, 2026: 229,097 Class A ordinary shares at $3.60 plus pre-funded warrants for 292,393 shares at $3.5904 per warrant with a $0.0096 residual exercise price, raising roughly $1.87 million gross for working capital. FT Global Capital acted as exclusive placement agent at a 7.0% cash fee plus expenses capped at $40,000 and 26,074 three-year warrants at $3.60. The pre-funded structure caps the purchaser near 9.99% beneficial ownership. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch post-deal overhang from warrant exercises.
